zh.explain: 正要遗世隐居学神仙，不料得到重用。就像日月当空光照天下，心地正直也必定能声名遍天下。
divination: 做事要有始有终，不要左右摇摆。
心中筹划的事情，必定会得到众多贵人相助。
zh.summary: 此卦贵人接引之象。所祈求之事若能合情合理、和合处理则大吉大利。

verse: On the way to the mountains to learn celestial ways,
Yet the King stops and summons you.
In clear skies, the Sun and the Moon beam on you,
Your righteous heart and name spread across the four seas.
interpretation: Always complete what you have started, do not be distracted.
No matter what burdens your mind, others will step up to assist you.
meaning: Someone of power and prestige will show you the way.
Everything will be in harmony and auspicious.
en.explain: Just when you are thinking of going to the mountains to learn the celestial ways, unexpectedly you get an important job.  Just like the light of the sun and moon shining on the world, an honest, righteous heart will surely be famous all over the world.
divination: Always complete what you have started, do not be swayed or distracted.
Whatever you plan, there will be many noble people to assist you.
items: There will be a good harvest

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages. zh key printed 畜养动物. en key 'Traveller'. en Husbandry printed 'Victorious' (zh says 兴盛), copied as printed. Poem line 2 printed 此知 (not 岂知), copied as printed.
